'''Waric''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stims]] at a kiosk in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Strategic Information Service base (Nar Shaddaa)|base]] located in [[Shadow Town]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
